bienvenida.texto: Confirm your language and country. Your country lets us show you real help where you live, should you ever need it. We don’t use your location, and nothing leaves your phone.
bienvenida.confirmarPista: Saves the language and country and opens the app

pais.explicacion: We only use it to show you helplines in your country. It stays on your phone.
pais.otro: Another country, or I’d rather not say
pais.otroDetalle: We’ll show you {{sitio}}, a worldwide directory of helplines, and a reminder to call the local emergency number wherever you are.

hoy.sinSanto: We don’t have today’s saint loaded yet
hoy.privacidad: No account. What you mark stays on your phone.

santo.sinHistoria: We don’t have this story loaded yet.
santo.noEncontradoDetalle: Their story may not be in the app yet.

emociones.guia: Pick one. You will get a Bible verse, a prayer and a saint who went through the same.
emociones.mosaicoPista: Opens a verse, a prayer and a companion saint
emociones.otraOracionPista: Shows another verse, prayer and saint for this feeling
emociones.otraAnuncio: For today, {{n}} of {{total}}. {{referencia}}. Walking with you: {{santo}}.
emociones.sinEntrada: A verse, a prayer and a saint for this feeling will be here soon.
emociones.noEncontrada: We could not find this feeling.
emociones.noEncontradaDetalle: Go back to the list and pick another one.

ayuda.titulo: You do not have to carry this alone.
ayuda.texto: If you feel very low or think about hurting yourself, talk to someone today. Asking for help is also an act of faith.
ayuda.llamarPista: Opens the dialer with the number filled in. You decide whether to call.
ayuda.marcarAMano: Dial it in your phone app.
ayuda.sinMarcador: We could not open the dialer. Dial the number on your phone.

ayuda.otroPaisPista: Choose your country to see its helplines
